verdict.rationale: doola's Partner API covers a substantial part of the core lifecycle: customers, LLC/C-Corp formation, formation documents, EIN workflows, name-rejection handling, the compliance calendar, annual report filing, reference data, plus webhooks and a sandbox. Several UI-side products show no API surface: registered-agent mail access is described as dashboard-only, and Pulse bookkeeping and banking guidance have no API evidence. The API is also partner-oriented, and the founder-facing MCP server is limited to forming a Wyoming LLC. Missing for 10: API coverage of the registered-agent mail dashboard, API coverage of Pulse bookkeeping/payouts/expenses, documented end-user (non-partner) API parity, a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent corroboration of parity.
